visual.description: Deep forest green used as the primary page and section background throughout the site.
Bright lime green used for primary CTA buttons, hero text highlights, and brand accent elements.
Mid-tone green used for elevated card surfaces, feature section backgrounds, and testimonial areas.
Off-white cream used for light card surfaces and secondary button fills on dark backgrounds.
White background of the navigation bar in its top-of-page state.
Deep forest green used for navigation text and logo in the top-of-page (white nav) state.
Lime green used for large display headings and footer section headings on dark green backgrounds.
Off-white cream used for body text and secondary headings rendered on dark green backgrounds.
Deep forest green used for body text and headings on light/cream surfaces.
Near-white text color used in the scrolled/opaque navigation state or on very dark green sections.
Slightly muted lime used for footer navigation links and section headings in the footer.
Soft peach/salmon color used in the data stack layer illustration as an ingestion-layer accent.
Soft lavender/periwinkle used in the data stack layer illustration for transformation layers.
Pale sky blue used in the data stack layer illustration for the warehouse layer.
Very light cream used for the raw data layer cubes in the stack illustration.
Brighter mid-tone green used as the background for the feature card section (Beyond BI section).
Dark green used for elevated card backgrounds within the mid-green sections.
Olive-lime used as a subtle hover or accent color on footer links and active states.
